verdict.rationale: Runloop repeatedly describes Devboxes as "secure sandboxed execution environments" and "isolated Linux sandbox environments," implying some isolation boundary, but the evidence never names or documents the actual isolation mechanism (e.g., microVM, Firecracker, gVisor, container-only) or any architecture diagram/security whitepaper explaining the boundary. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the underlying isolation technology (microVM/hypervisor-level or equivalent), any security architecture doc or third-party audit confirming hard isolation guarantees.
